name: firewallLoggingEnabled
definition: True when every enabled firewall rule the tool reads logs to a log forwarding destination at the end of the session.
population: the enabled firewall rules the tool reads; denominator = every enabled rule read
evidenceRequiredForTrue: A complete read of the rule base showing every enabled rule with a log forwarding profile and not turning off log at session end; an error, empty or possibly cut-off read is Not evaluated.
citations: PAN-OS 11.1 XML API and configure CLI command hierarchy (docs.paloaltonetworks.com/pan-os/11-1/pan-os-panorama-api)
Public OpenAPI reference for Cloud NGFW for AWS (pan.dev/cloudngfw/aws/api/)

changeLog.change: Registered so the Palo Alto firewall transformations (hardware and cloud) can emit it. Meaning is vendor-neutral and written from public references only; no real device or customer read, so the key stays proposed and V0.

notes: Whether the named log forwarding destination actually receives logs is not read.
